before.name: Scott Sakiyama
before.description: Scott Sakiyama is an Oak Park attorney detained by federal immigration agents on October 20, 2025 while following their vehicles and warning neighbors with his horn and a whistle. He told the Chicago Tribune that agents held him for about an hour, largely in a parked van outside the Broadview facility, then returned him to his car with a citation. He disputed their allegation that he cut off their vehicle.

credit: Wednesday Journal; photographer unnamed (report by Brendan Heffernan)
